tests.stimulus: Use APB_ADDR_WIDTH12, known binary inputs stable before rising HCLK, and an independently asserted/released reset. Establish state through valid APB accesses and native event history only. Assert reset asynchronously at startup and during active counting, pending compare pulses and bus accesses; observe immediate counter/IRQ/busy state and combinational bus outputs, then release and restart.
tests.expected: All registered logical state clears asynchronously and reset-time writes cannot survive. Bus ready/error/read behavior still reflects current access pins during reset; counting resumes only from later valid configuration/event history.
tests.checker: A self-contained native model independently predicts abstract elapsed/divider histories, sampled reference events and APB transactions from inputs only. DUT and expected outputs have separate wires. The monitor compares every output with four-state inequality1ns after every rising HCLK and asynchronous reset assertion, emits UVM_ERROR on any mismatch, and enforces finite nonvacuous comparison/reset counts.
